blind.description: A stylized potted topiary featuring a dense, spherical head of stylized scalloped green foliage supported by a short, vertical wooden trunk. The trunk is set into dark brown soil within a round terracotta-orange clay pot with a rounded rim and ribbed base. The surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with no floating pieces or broken geometry, and the pot rests flatly directly on the ground without an extra base.
blind.from_above: A round green textured sphere resembling a leafy topiary ball or bush, with scalloped overlapping leaf details.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.8 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.3 feet in diameter at the foliage.
